completion_data.completion_summary: Gave the sapience extension repo-scoped storage and per-dispatch context injection via two new scripts (sapience-retrieve.sh, sapience-remember.sh), swapped core's orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh Stage 3.5 memory_context call site to the new retrieval script with guard/wrapper/argument shape unchanged, and amended the extension's design record to document the shipped mechanism and its three hazards (no delete API, unreviewed permanent writes, two differently-shaped vault populations).

memory_candidates.content: A deployed .claude/scripts/<name>.sh that sources lib/common.sh relative to its own SCRIPT_DIR cannot be invoked standalone from its agent-system/extensions/<ext>/scripts/ source-store location before a deploy, because lib/common.sh only exists in the shared deployed tree. Pre-deploy verification of a brand-new sibling script is limited to shellcheck plus argument-validation paths that return before the source line; deeper invocation checks (real network calls, --dry-run body shape) must wait for the first deploy.

verify-deploy.sh's full gate battery (especially gate 8's shell-suite run-all.sh, timeout_s=1500) can take 10-25+ minutes end to end, more under concurrent repo contention from another active session. The honest, fast covering check for a narrow change is a suite_selection_select-driven run-all.sh --only subset (or a scoped --only-gate N invocation), not a routine full unqualified run; reserve the full run for the phase(s) whose own Verification Tier is 'full' and genuinely has no cheaper subset.

On the Sapience hosted vault, /v1/search's source= parameter matches a substring of each KO's provenance field as a hard pre-filter (not a ranking signal), while the structured project field is silently ignored and source_loc is not search-matchable at all. Any per-repo or per-tenant scoping scheme against this vault must embed the scope marker directly in provenance text and write through POST /ingest-kos (never the MCP sapience_remember tool, whose provenance string is connector-fixed with no injectable marker).
